about: The same journey with reduced motion. Scripted input for a capture, not hands-on.

steps.say: REDUCED MOTION (MOTION: OFF) -- EVERY TURN AND LENS MOVE IS A CUT; THE GATES HOLD STILL
REDUCED -- THE THREAD IS SIMPLY THERE; THE SAME INFORMATION, THE SAME ACTIONS
REDUCED -- DOWN: THE NEXT SHUT WAY, THE NEW THREAD AT ONCE
REDUCED -- E: FOLLOW IT; THE MAP AS IT WAS LEFT
REDUCED -- TAB, THEN Q: OUT AND BACK, NOTHING LOST
